kana.text: だいにっぽんていこく

gloss.text: Empire of Japan (Japan's official name under the Meiji Constitution)

reviewForms.reading: だいにっぽんていこく

gloss.text: counter for stories, episodes of TV series, etc.
to go back on one's word
to be on a par with
to fire someone up (with scolding, corporal punishment, etc.)

info: often as 〜が言う通りに〜 or 〜の言う通りに〜
after a noun or the -te form of a verb
after the dictionary form of a verb

gloss.text: to be able to manage somehow or other
for (e.g. "she dances well for an eight-year old")

info: counter for layers in the ichi-ni-san counting system
contraction of ..て or で plus 置く

gloss.text: to do something in readiness for
